veranderings.voor: Wie nie as wit ingedeel is nie, is baie van hul regte ontneem, veral swart mense.
veranderings.na: Mense wat nie as wit ingedeel is nie, veral swart mense, is baie van hul regte ontneem.
veranderings.rede: Singular 'wie' clashes with plural 'hul', and 'veral swart mense' dangles at the end; the qualifier now sits beside the group it narrows, with meaning and 'ingedeel' unchanged.

veranderings.voor: Dit is om dinge soos kragmaste stukkend te maak om die regering onder druk te sit.
veranderings.na: Sabotasie beteken om dinge soos kragmaste stukkend te maak om die regering onder druk te plaas.
veranderings.rede: 'Dit is om' could point back to the planning rather than to sabotage, so the term is named as the subject; 'onder druk plaas' is the standard idiom and matches the glossary's 'druk ... plaas'.

veranderings.voor: Van sy 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
veranderings.na: Van Mandela se 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
veranderings.rede: The block opens under a new heading with a bare 'sy', so the referent is named once for a reader who starts here.
For heavy physical labour such as breaking stone, 'swaar werk' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'harde werk' leans towards working diligently.
A bare '18' after 'mense van' reads incomplete; 'jaar' makes clear it is an age.
'Teen mekaar was' is loose and colloquial; 'teen mekaar gestaan het' is the idiomatic way to say people were opposed.

vlae.teks: vir die eerste keer saam stem
vlae.rede: Correctly written as two words (vote together), but a Grade 5 reader may read it as 'saamstem' (agree); not changed because any rewording risks altering the meaning, so the reviewer may want to consider it.
